text: Everyone must help their country in times of war. To what extent do you agree with this
statement? [30]
To what extent should towns be designed to support people’s needs? [30]
Non-fiction books will never be as popular as fiction books. To what extent do you agree
with this statement? [30]
Evaluate the view that the aim of prison should be to improve people rather than punish them.
The rights of people to protest on the streets should always be protected. Examine this
statement. [30]
To what extent has globalisation improved people’s lives in your country? [30]
Government investment is essential for local community arts to survive. Discuss. [30]
To what extent does a plant-based diet ensure a healthy lifestyle? [30]
Actors playing leading roles in movies are too often chosen for their physical appearance.
Discuss. [30]
To what extent is the introduction of electric vehicles a positive development? [30]
